instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact company color scheme: deep navy (#0A121E, #0F1C2E), cyan accents (#06B6D4), amber swirl accents (#F97316).
Use French language for all content, headings, badges, and blog articles.
Ensure all interactive components have exact data-testid attributes matching the list provided.
Install required icons library (@phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react) and framer-motion if needed for smooth scroll and animations.
Keep the homepage hero clean and open, avoid clutter, and highlight direct contact actions (438-680-4054, yara.globalair@gmail.com).
Make sure floating contact button pulses smoothly at bottom-right corner.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default centered plain layouts. Build layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphic overlays.
Do NOT use universal transition 'transition: all'. Apply explicit transitions like transition-color, transition-transform.
Do NOT add text-align center to .App container.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with subtle hover glow matching cyan/amber brand accents.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭). Use clean Phosphor or Lucide SVG icons.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive links, buttons, form controls, and cards.
